answer: An admission auction stops bulk fake identities at the gate. Each epoch the network opens 200 slots on a flat mesa for sealed bids. An agent stakes its kernel identity, signs with a quill signature no copy can forge, and locks its bid for 20 epochs. Only 200 win. At a clearing price of 500 units, forging 1,000 identities costs 500,000 units locked 20 epochs, while an honest agent pays 500 once and earns undiluted rewards within 6 epochs.
